steps.note: Configure the event as an RFQ so it has a vendor pricing sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product for the vendor to quote.
Invite one QA vendor who will attempt the invalid bid.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor portal can access it.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the supplier portal.
Enter the invalid negative price requested by the case.
Attempt submission and require visible refusal evidence with the price validation message.
Return to the buyer console to verify no bid was created.
Confirm the buyer sees no vendor response after the refused submission.
